response.sql: WITH tel AS (SELECT telescref, AVG(pulsepersec) AS avg_pulse FROM signals GROUP BY telescref), b1 AS (SELECT AVG(pulsepersec) AS v FROM signals), k1 AS (SELECT t.telescref, t.avg_pulse FROM tel t, b1 WHERE t.avg_pulse > b1.v), b2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_pulse) AS v FROM k1), fin AS (SELECT k.telescref, k.avg_pulse FROM k1 k, b2 WHERE k.avg_pulse > b2.v) SELECT AVG(f.avg_pulse) AS mean_avg_pulse, AVG(f.avg_pulse - b1.v) AS mean_excess_over_first_baseline, AVG(f.avg_pulse - b2.v) AS mean_excess_over_second_baseline FROM fin f, b1, b2

assumptions.assumption: Telescopes whose signals all have NULL pulsepersec have NULL average and are dropped by the comparisons, so they are excluded.
The first baseline is the average over all signals with non-null pulsepersec, including signals from every telescope.
